title: AI's Next Bottleneck May Be Electricity | English News Listening
description:
Learn English through a current technology story: why AI data centers are increasingly becoming energy projects.

This lesson uses source-backed reporting and official energy outlooks to explain how electricity demand, grid access, and power generation are becoming central constraints on AI infrastructure.

Sources include Reuters, the International Energy Agency (IEA), and the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA).

#EnglishLearning #EnglishListening #AI #Technology
